metaTitle: No-Minimum Custom Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop no-minimum custom lanyards and badges. Perfect for small teams and events. Order low quantities with no bulk minimums at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Not every order needs to fill a warehouse. Our no-minimum custom lanyards and badges let you order as few as one or two pieces, ideal for small businesses, startups, one-off events, or testing a design before committing to larger quantities. You get the same professional quality and personalization options as bulk orders, with the flexibility to buy exactly what you need.
heroAltText: A close-up of a no-minimum custom lanyard with an attached badge holder, featuring a colorful printed design and metal clip.
